controls.name: Zero-quartet multiplier twin: zeta(s) m(s), m rational in s(1-s) of degree 0, two on-line zero pairs at +-g1, +-g2 exchanged for the quartet 1/2 +- eta +- i (g1+g2)/2
keeps: every prime-power atom of log zeta: EP, GEOM, SIZE on atoms
lacks: SUPP (absolutely continuous density D(x) = -4 x^(-1/2) cos(gbar log x)(cosh(eta log x) - cos(d log x)))
controls.defect: sup abs D <= 8 e^-2 (eta^2 + d^2)/(1/2 - eta)^2; 1.971e-3 measured at zeros 6709, 6710, eta = 0.01
controls.kills: devices reading FE with atom-level multiplicative structure (U1) or with size of mu or log coefficients (U2, SIZE branch) and not the absence of coefficient mass off log N
controls.label: PROVED (construction, defect bound); MEASURED (four instances)

controls.name: Real-zero twin: zeta(s) (t^2 + b^2)/(t^2 - g1^2), t^2 = s(1-s) - 1/4
lacks: POS (density -2 x^(-1/2)(cosh(b log x) - cos(g1 log x)) <= 0)
controls.kills: steps that use an upper bound for Lambda or positivity of the atoms only, together with FE
controls.label: PROVED; MEASURED at b = 0.3

controls.name: T-NR at a base with no rational power: zeta(s)(q^(s-1/2) + c + q^(1/2-s)), q = 1 + sqrt 2, 2 < abs c < q^(1/2) + q^(-1/2)
keeps: integer-frequency part equal to c zeta
Hecke relations at every rational prime
lacks: GEOM, SIZE, POS at the one added generalised prime q
controls.kills: steps that read coefficients at integers only, or covariance at rational primes only, together with FE
controls.label: PROVED; MEASURED at c = 2.1

lemmas.statement: zeta's FE, only pole a simple one at 1, Lambda_G - Lambda a non-negative measure with Laplace-Stieltjes transform -m'/m in a half-plane: G = c zeta
lemmas.label: PROVED given Landau's theorem (classical, recalled)

lemmas.statement: a symmetric Dirichlet-polynomial multiplier 1 + sum c_j (l_j^(s-1/2) + l_j^(1/2-s)) with a zero in the closed strip has sum abs(c_j)(l_j^(1/2) + l_j^(-1/2)) >= 1
lemmas.label: PROVED

lemmas.statement: fourth instance of Lemma F: multiplication by a ZQ multiplier; stable for atom-level conditions, FE, linear classes stable under bounded rational multipliers
lemmas.label: PROVED as an instance; stability to be checked per step
